errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: The page hit an unexpected error. Reload to continue.
errorBoundary.interviewTitle: The interview screen hit a problem
errorBoundary.interviewBody: Your progress is saved. Reload the page to reconnect and continue where you left off.

invite.invalidDesc: This invitation link is no longer valid. Please contact the organization that invited you.
invite.followupBonusNote: Follow-up questions add extra time as you go, so your clock can grow.
invite.otpDesc: Enter the code sent to <1>{{email}}</1>, or click the sign-in link in that same email — either one continues automatically.

apply.invalidDesc: This application link is no longer active.

cv.title: Upload your CV
cv.description: We read your CV to open the interview with a short conversation about your real experience, and to evaluate you fairly against it. PDF only.
cv.loadFailed: Could not check your CV. Please reload the page.
cv.dropHere: Drop your CV here, or click to choose a file
cv.errorTooLarge: Your CV must be 5 MB or smaller.
cv.errorUpload: We couldn't upload your CV. Please try again.
cv.parseIncomplete: We could store your CV but couldn't read it fully. You can replace it with a clearer PDF.
cv.requiredBeforeStart: Your CV is required before the interview can start.

start.title: Preparing your interview
start.subtitle: This usually takes about 15 seconds. Your microphone stays muted until you unmute it.
start.preparingCv: Reading your CV and preparing your questions
start.tip1: You can re-read any question in the transcript during the interview.
start.tip2: Answer naturally — the interviewer waits for you to finish before responding.
start.tip3: You can skip a question if you prefer; it will be marked as skipped.
start.slow: Taking a little longer than usual — still working on it.
start.stuck: This is taking too long. Reloading the page will reconnect you without losing your place.

workspace.timeBonusTitle: Extra time earned from follow-up questions
workspace.interviewerSpeakingHint: The interviewer is speaking. Listen for the next prompt.
workspace.listeningHint: Your microphone is live -- speak whenever you're ready.

subsection.label: Interview part
subsection.nowDiscussion: Background done — moving to the discussion questions

workspace.submitOnceReady: Submit once you are ready to finish the technical problem.
workspace.ttsRetryingDesc: Just a moment — this should clear up shortly. You can still end the session anytime from the button above.
workspace.ttsSwitchingKeyTitle: One moment, warming up the interviewer's voice...
workspace.ttsSwitchingKeyDesc: Just switching things over behind the scenes — this only takes a second. You can still end the session anytime from the button above.
workspace.ttsGaveUpTitle: Switched to a backup voice for this line
workspace.ttsGaveUpDesc: The interviewer's main voice is temporarily unavailable, so your browser is reading this line instead. The interview is still running normally — you can keep going, or end the session anytime from the button above.

fullscreenGrace.body: You've left fullscreen — return within {{seconds}}s to avoid this being flagged for review.

workspace.youHaveFloor: You have the floor. Take your time and explain your thinking.

adminLayout.verifyFailed: We couldn't verify your access right now.

jobsList.desc: Manage job postings and their interview configurations.

jobCreate.durationNotSet: Job created, but setting the duration failed. Please update it below.
jobCreate.desc: Fill out the details to generate an interview configuration.

jobDetail.publishConfirm: Publish this job? This is irreversible — there is no un-publish, and structural edits (sections/questions) will be locked afterward.
jobDetail.jobNotFoundDesc: The job you are looking for does not exist or has been deleted.

criteriaEditor.title: Assessment Criteria
criteriaEditor.description: Configure the behavioral dimensions the AI will evaluate, and how much each counts toward the criteria-weighted score.

sectionsEditor.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this section?
sectionsEditor.title: Interview Sections
sectionsEditor.comingSoonHover: Coming soon — not yet supported by the interview engine
sectionsEditor.failedToReorderFull: Failed to fully reorder sections. State has been re-synced.
sectionsEditor.backgroundToggle: Start with a background conversation based on the candidate's CV
sectionsEditor.backgroundHelp: Short, CV-grounded questions asked before the discussion questions. Their time is carved out of this section's budget.
sectionsEditor.backgroundSummary: Verbal {{total}} min — up to {{background}} min background, at least {{discussion}} min discussion
sectionsEditor.backgroundSummaryNoBudget: Set the section's time budget to see the split.
sectionsEditor.backgroundTooLong: Background must be at most half of the section budget ({{max}} min).
sectionsEditor.timingHint: How long this section lasts. Section budgets add up to the duration candidates see on the invitation.
sectionsEditor.backgroundOn: On — start with questions from the candidate's CV
sectionsEditor.backgroundOff: Off — go straight to the discussion questions

questionsHint.VERBAL: Asked verbatim, in this order, after the background conversation. Each allows up to two follow-ups.
questionsHint.CODING: Solved live in the editor, in this order.
questionsHint.MCQ: Answered on screen, in this order.

sectionsEditor.summaryWithBackground: {{total}} min — up to {{background}} min background ({{bgCount}} questions from the CV) + at least {{discussion}} min discussion ({{questions}})

candidateAccess.title: Candidate Access
candidateAccess.manageAccessDescription: Manage how candidates access this job's interview.
candidateAccess.publicAccessDesc: Anyone with the link can apply and start the interview.
candidateAccess.invitationOnlyDesc: Only candidates you explicitly invite can access the interview.

publishSetup.title: Publish Job Setup
publishSetup.question: How should candidates access this job?
publishSetup.invitationOnlyDesc: Invite specific candidates via email. Best for targeted hiring.
publishSetup.publicLinkDesc: Anyone with the link can apply. Best for sourcing new candidates.

waitingRoom.title: Section complete
waitingRoom.subtitle: Take a moment to prepare
waitingRoom.descWithNext: Great work! You've completed the {{sectionType}} section. Your next section is {{nextType}}.
waitingRoom.descLast: Great work! You've completed all sections. The interview is almost done.
waitingRoom.timeNote: This break is free time — the interview clock is paused.
waitingRoom.autoAdvance: You'll be advanced automatically if you don't continue within 5 minutes.
waitingRoom.fullscreenRequired: Fullscreen is required to continue. Please allow fullscreen and try again.

endSectionEarly.title: End this section early?
endSectionEarly.description: The remaining questions in this section won't be asked — this can't be undone. You'll move to a short break before the next section.
endSectionEarly.descriptionLast: The remaining questions in this section won't be asked — this can't be undone. You'll move to the closing.

endInterview.title: End interview?
endInterview.description: Your current progress will be saved, but you will leave this live session.
endInterview.descriptionPreStart: You haven't started yet, so there's nothing to save. You're free to close this window at any time.

intro.title: {{role}} interview
intro.subtitle: You're about to begin a live, voice-based interview with our AI interviewer. When you're ready, press Start Session.
intro.instructionsLabel: A note from the hiring team
intro.defaultInstructions: We're excited to learn more about you. Please answer the questions naturally and take your time to think.
intro.rule2: Ensure your microphone is connected and working.
intro.rule3: Speak clearly and naturally; the AI will listen and respond.
intro.tipMic: Make sure your microphone is on and you're in a quiet space.
intro.tipSections: The interview is split into sections, with a short break in between each one.
intro.endedDesc: You've left before starting. Nothing was recorded, and you're free to close this window.
intro.startFailed: Failed to start the interview session. Please try again.
intro.endFailed: Failed to end the interview. Please try again.

consent.title: Recording & monitoring
consent.body: To help our hiring team review this interview fairly, we may record video and monitor certain in-app activity while you're in session, including: fullscreen-exit events (if you leave fullscreen) and focus-loss events (if you switch away from this tab or window). This is used only to support our hiring team's review — nothing about you is judged or decided automatically.
consent.checkboxLabel: I understand the fullscreen rule and consent to this recording and monitoring.
consent.recordFailed: Failed to record your consent. Please try again.

devices.error: We couldn't access your camera or microphone. Check your browser permissions and reload; the interview can still run audio-only.
devices.released: Devices checked — camera and microphone will be handed to the interview room.

fullscreen.title: The interview runs in fullscreen
fullscreen.body: When you press Start, this page switches to fullscreen and stays there until the interview ends. This keeps you focused and gives the hiring team confidence that the session was completed without distractions.
fullscreen.point1: If you leave fullscreen (Esc, switching windows or tabs), a 10-second countdown appears — return to fullscreen to continue.
fullscreen.point2: If you don't return in time, the interview ends and is recorded as terminated. It can't be resumed.
fullscreen.point3: Fullscreen is required to start. Closing the tab also ends the interview.

intro.fullscreenRequired: Fullscreen is required to start the interview. Please allow fullscreen and try again.

jobResults.title: {{job}} — Results
jobResults.noCandidates: No candidates have started this interview yet.
jobResults.tableCaption: Candidates who have taken this interview, with score, evidence and integrity status

deleteModal.title: Delete Candidate
deleteModal.description: Remove {{name}} from this job's results? This permanently deletes their interview transcript, evaluation, scores, and recording. It cannot be undone.

incomplete.title: Incomplete session
incomplete.ended: ended before all sections were completed
incomplete.body: This interview {{what}}. The score and summary below are based on partial evidence — review the transcript and recording directly before deciding.

score.neither: Not enough evidence to compute either score.
score.noHolistic: Not enough evidence for a holistic score.
score.noWeighted: No scored criteria to compute a weighted score.

recording.unsupported: Your browser does not support video playback.
recording.mockData: This result is mock data, included to show what a completed candidate review looks like — no interview actually happened for it.
recording.none: No recording is available for this session (recording may not have been enabled, camera access was declined, or the recording failed to start).

override.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you overriding the AI's suggestion?

integrity.title: Integrity Timeline
integrity.none: No integrity flags were recorded for this session — fullscreen, tab focus, and camera presence all stayed within bounds throughout.
integrity.TAB_HIDDEN: Switched away from the interview tab

assessment.title: Overall Assessment
assessment.placeholderWarning: This session was never fully evaluated by AI — the summary and scores below are a placeholder. The real transcript and question records are still shown accurately; click "Regenerate Evaluation" to generate a real assessment from them.
assessment.evidenceNote: Based on {{percent}}% of the assessed criteria having enough transcript evidence to score confidently.

record.title: Full Record
record.subtitle: Question-by-question detail, the technical submission, and the full transcript.
record.noQuestions: No questions were recorded for this session.
record.seeTranscript: See the full transcript below for exactly what the candidate said in response.
